what_this_is: Live full-roster intent-to-slots configuration; experiment readiness and committed generation/tokenizer exposure plans govern admission.
delivery_basis: The experiment predeclares the registered slurp-intent-slots-delivery-v1 deterministic phase-pair join. Retain raw generation, derive the joined delivery, then score the joined complete roster once.
live_state_transfer: The slots phase appends the direct phase state through the shared phase-material registry; no sealed predecessor receipt is used.
geometry_basis: Both phases use the inherited np4 / four-slot / 16,384-token geometry and request max_tokens=256 through the experiment fragment; no phase-specific decoding extension is introduced.

facet_source.embedded_signal: text: Omni-Embed-Nemotron-3B over the 11,514 governed SLURP TRAIN utterance texts, prompt 'passage: ', mean-pooled and L2-normalised; one vector per content facet id facet:content:<slurp_id>. The KEY side is knowledge text by construction and is unconstrained by the owner's 2026-09-06 query-signal rule.

query_source.embedded_signal: speech: Omni-Embed-Nemotron-3B over the DEV-1000 recording of this row, prompt 'query: ' through the encoder's own sentence_transformers.jinja wrapper, mean-pooled over the attention mask and L2-normalised. Set q-speech-nemotron of the sealed 2026-09-06 MF-7b pass; no text of any kind enters this vector.
